checks: Fresh isolated database: five migrations and repeat execution
Interactive-admin command supports secure stdin verification and refuses repeated bootstrap
Registration normalization, duplicates, validation, no auto-login and role injection rejection
Argon2id parameters, normalized login, host-only HttpOnly cookie and seven-day absolute session
Signed CSRF cookie/header, strict Origin and anonymous-to-session binding
Personal data, stale versions, forged fields and concurrent profile updates
Real avatar decoding, size/dimension/quota limits, ownership, public binding, detach and cleanup
Logout revokes current session while another browser session stays valid
Password change revokes every old session and accepts the new password
Expired sessions are rejected without silent renewal
Ordinary/moderator/admin restrictions, board authorization and last-administrator protection
Ban revokes sessions and pauses tasks; unban does not resume tasks
Admin reset: old sessions revoked, change-only token, single use, expiry and reissue
Management actions audited without passwords or credentials
Implemented JSON responses validate against the existing 4.3 OpenAPI schemas
Browser registration/login/profile/avatar/change/logout and administrator reset flows
Browser database-failure registration retains non-secret fields and shows no success
Accounts and still-valid sessions persist through API and database restart
Concurrent administrator changes preserve one usable administrator
Five-failure account/IP throttling, Retry-After, spoofed forwarding rejection and Redis-loss persistence
Access logs contain no tested passwords, session tokens or reset credentials
